title: Account Safeguard: QBR Kit + Exec Escalation & Save Plays
content:
Purpose:
This is a compact, reusable QBR kit and account-safeguard playbook designed for mid-to-high ARR accounts that show early signs of churn. Use it as the working template for the first 30 days of triage, the 30–90 day mitigation plan, and the exec escalation cadence if we cross defined risk thresholds.

Audience:
- CSMs owning renewals and post-sale GTM
- Solutions / SEs for technical saves
- Sales/AM for commercial remedies
- Customer Success Leadership for escalations

Quick notes (working draft):
- Tone: operational, not punitive. This doc is a kit — copy sections into the customer-facing QBR or internal escalation thread.
- Keep play entries short, add links to evidence (logs, error rates, CSAT snippets).
- This file intentionally mixes checklists + email templates + slides outline to speed QBR prep.

1) Risk scoring rubric (CS triage) — single-line summary + trigger values
- Health Score (0–100): composite of usage, latency errors, support volume, CSAT, and activation metrics.
- Bands: Green 75+, Yellow 50–74, Amber 35–49, Red <35
- Leading signals (any 2 within 14 days triggers escalation to "Amber"): sharp drop in daily active keys (>30%), 3+ P1/P2 incidents in 14d, CSAT drop >=20% vs last QBR, repeated model-quality complaints.
- Critical triggers (immediate exec alert): contract <90 days AND Health <40 OR customer verbally says they are evaluating alternatives.

2) QBR template (internal + customer-facing slices) — copy into slides
- Slide 1: Executive summary (1 slide): current engagement state, renewal window, ask of execs.
- Slide 2: Health snapshot (1 slide): Health Score, top 3 risk drivers, usage trend chart.
- Slide 3: Incident & reliability timeline (1 slide): incidents last 90 days, MTTR, residual items.
- Slide 4: Value delivered (2 bullets): concrete product outcomes, cost/perf delta.
- Slide 5: Open blockers & dependency map (1 slide): internal owners, partner blockers.
- Slide 6: Save plays & ask (1 slide): sequence of expected actions and approvals required.
- Slide 7: Renewal options (1 slide): standard renewal, pilot extension, bridge contract.
- Slide 8: Next steps & dates (1 slide): triage owner, escalation readiness, demo/review slots.

3) 0–30 day rapid triage checklist (CSM)
- Day 0: Confirm renewal date and primary economic buyer.
- Pull: usage logs, error logs, top 20 customer prompts (anonymized), last 3 support tickets.
- Customer conversation: schedule 30–45m sync separate from QBR: goal = surface top concerns, listen for intent to evaluate.
- Quick technical plays (SE): verify model variant pinned, review KV cache hit rates, check prefix caching misconfig.
- Outreach: send one-line recap to exec sponsor if critical trigger met.

4) 30–90 day mitigation plan (multi-team)
- Week 1–2: Stabilize
  - Tech: deploy hotfix or config rollback if regression identified.
  - CS: run targeted enablement sessions for top 5 power users.
  - Sales/AM: re-open contract talk to surface commercial pressure points.
- Week 3–6: Restore confidence
  - Measure: track weekly Health Score increments and CSAT for affected cohorts.
  - Product: schedule a short demo showing roadmap features that address their ask.
- Week 7–12: Lock-in
  - Offer: limited bridge pricing or commit to a staged milestone-based renewal (avoid blanket discounts).
  - Contract: defined SLA addendum for availability/latency tied to credits or rollback clauses.

5) Exec escalation matrix (who, when, what)
- Tier 1 (CS Director): auto-notify on Amber band or 3+ P2s; owner = CSM; timeline = 48h response with mitigation plan.
- Tier 2 (Head of CS + Head of Sales): if no improvement in 7 days OR any contract <60 days with Health <45.
- Tier 3 (VPs + CTO/Head of Product): immediate brief if customer requests legal/commercial pause OR public-signal risk (press/industry).
- For all tiers: include a one-page "what-we-did" appendix and customer ZIP of telemetry snippets.

6) Save plays (examples, pick & tailor)
- "Technical rapid-fix": EMERG SE sprint (2 days) + customer-facing postmortem + free monitoring for 90 days.
- "Performance bump": migrate to a higher-performance model variant for 60 days on us (limited to 1N workloads).
- "Commitment pilot": sign 6-month pilot at reduced unit rate with predefined KPIs; renewal contingent on KPI attainment.
- "Commercial concession": targeted credits applied if SLA missed 2x in 90d. Always require exec approval if >5% ARR impact.
- "Customer engineering partnership": free SE days for integration improvements, paired with published success criteria.

7) Sample email templates (CS -> exec sponsor)
- Internal alert (to Head CS):
  Subject: Amber alert: [Account] — Health 34, renewal in 58 days
  Body: Quick summary, top 3 issues, proposed 48h mitigation, asks (SE time, Sales outreach), links to evidence.

- Customer outreach (CS -> Economic buyer):
  Subject: Quick sync re: [Product area] — ensuring value ahead of renewal
  Body: One-line value reminder, 30–45m availability, optional troubleshooting session, attach short incident timeline.

8) Tracking sheet (columns to add to spreadsheet)
- account_name, account_owner, ARR, renewal_date, health_score, health_band, top_issue_1, last_incident_date, days_since_first_signal, escalation_tier, requested_actions, committed_by, next_check_in_date, status_notes

9) Evidence packets (what to include in escalation doc)
- Customer quotes (support tickets, support calls), CSAT snippets, usage delta charts, KVI/Metric deltas, SE notes + diff of config changes, timeline of fixes and open items.

10) KPIs to measure success of playbook
- Time-to-first-mitigation: target <48h
- Health Score recovery: +15 pts within 30 days after mitigation
- Renewal conversion: baseline +15% saves vs historical cohort for accounts >$100k ARR
- Customer sentiment lift: Net Promoter delta +10 after 60 days

11) Governance & approvals
- Any concession >5% ARR: require Head of Sales sign-off + Finance review.
- Any SLA amendment: Legal + Contract Ops review (3–5 business days).

12) Notes to self / TODOs (rough)
- Add slide snippets for "customer cost of downtime" metric (need finance template).
- Create templated telemetry export for top-20 prompts (anonymize automatically).
- Build Confluence macro to auto-populate the tracking sheet row from Zendesk/Jira.

Appendix: Quick copy/paste blocks (internal)
- One-line exec brief: [Account] at-risk: Health 34, renewal in 58d, 3 P2 incidents in 21d. Proposed: 48h hotfix + 60-day performance pilot on us. Ask: approve up to 3 SE days + one-time credit not to exceed 3% ARR.
- Slack shorthand for urgent channel: "cs-escalate: [Acct] health34 renew58d. Need SE + Sales now."

End.

Document history and provenance: created as a consolidation of repeated QBR prep notes observed across top tier churn cases (Nov 2025 retrospective). This version is intentionally prescriptive and compact to be copy-pasted into customer slides and internal threads.

-- Sofia R. (CS)"
